summary: Aldel Financial II Inc. filed an 8-K on September 22, 2026, disclosing a founder share conversion notice from sponsor Aldel Investors II LLC. Effective October 5, 2026, all but one Class B share will convert one-for-one into Class A shares; other Class B holders also indicated conversions. Post-conversion, shares outstanding comprise 29,868,213 Class A shares, including 23,000,000 public and 707,500 private-unit shares, and one Class B share. No trust funds were deposited or released; converted shares remain subject to existing transfer restrictions. No board recommendation or advisor was disclosed, and no deal terms, premium, or closing date were stated. The overhang of 6,160,713 Converted Class A Shares may weigh on ALDF, with what to watch being trust status, potential redemptions or extension, and a de-SPAC announcement.
